items.title: Wall Street Analysts Think Emcor Group (EME) Is a Good Investment: Is It?
items.summary: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for Emcor Group (EME) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?
